original_test_intent: Verify a fully loaded platform sustains concurrent eight-path network, storage, GPU and memory stress for 12 hours at 40C and -5% 5V/3.3V rails, with network throughput above the approved 80% baseline and no platform errors.
original_method: Freeze the eight NIC/BDF/netdev/peer/IP/port map, GPU and DIMM topology, and immutable safe storage targets; define synchronized workload profiles and load floors; establish calibrated high-temperature/negative-rail conditions; start all workloads within the approved overlap window and sustain them for 12 hours while collecting per-path throughput, FIO integrity/performance, GPU/XID, memory/ECC, power/thermal/RAS/link and heartbeat evidence; stop on bounded limits, clean up safely and restore nominal conditions.
manual_activity: Operators configure peers/cabling and safe storage, control chamber/rails, supervise the concurrent run and restore the lab.
required_inputs: Immutable FIO targets, exclusions, backup and profile
GPU/DIMM identities, tools and load floors
Exact concurrent start/stop overlap and 12-hour duration
40C/-5% rail limits plus domain-specific error/thermal/performance aborts
safety_requirements: Never infer storage devices or run unapproved writes
Verify peer isolation and management-path separation
Use calibrated rail/temperature measurement and OOB access
Abort on data error, XID/ECC/RAS, link loss, thermal/power or heartbeat limit
Restore workloads, network, storage and environment in controlled order
agent_execution_scope: May validate identities/configs and analyze supplied concurrent evidence
Must not select destructive targets, control lab equipment or claim DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve topology, workload matrix, baselines and limits

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Correctly rejects remote-only margin execution, but the generic full load lacks target-safe and synchronized per-domain commands.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only the approved orchestrated SST/FIO/GPU/memory profiles against mapped endpoints and safe targets after stable margin is confirmed.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Eight network paths, FIO/GPU/DIMM concurrent stress, 12 hours, 40C, -5% rails and >80% network criterion are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use one synchronized run manifest binding every endpoint/target and workload interval to common rail, chamber and health telemetry.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds immutable identities, safe storage policy, concurrency proof, interpretable 80% baseline and domain-specific abort/recovery.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Separate component runs or staggered workloads cannot reproduce shared power, cooling, PCIe, memory and I/O contention.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Aggregate network throughput may hide one weak NIC, and a successful 12-hour duration may conceal corrected errors or corrupted storage data.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines whether 80% applies per path or aggregate, the line-rate/encoding baseline, storage destructiveness and acceptable corrected-error/performance degradation under negative margin.
expected_evidence: Calibrated chamber and rail time series
GPU load/XID, memory coverage/ECC, CPU/power/thermal/RAS telemetry
Exact concurrent overlap, abort/cleanup and nominal post-health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source consistently requests concurrent full loading and includes an 80% network criterion; missing topology and detailed thresholds are owner inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The purpose and workload domains are clear; safe execution is manual after targets, profiles and thresholds are approved.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Stability row33 Wistron-Margin-00032-V002: approve eight-NIC/BDF/netdev/peer/IP/port map and 80%-ideal formula, immutable FIO targets/backup/profile, GPU/DIMM tools/load floors, exact 12-hour concurrent overlap, 40C/-5% tolerances, power/cooling/thermal/RAS/link/data limits, OOB abort, cleanup and restoration.

review_improvement: Makes the full-load claim depend on traceable concurrent coverage and safe per-domain evidence rather than elapsed time and aggregate network output.
independent_technical_reasoning: The stressors share PCIe, memory bandwidth, power and cooling, so concurrency is the essential coverage. Negative margin may surface as one NIC's retries, corrected memory errors or storage resets while aggregate load continues. Per-path and per-target evidence synchronized to the full overlap is necessary.
